title: Leptocaramine from Hypecoum erectum inhibits inflammatory responses via CSF2-NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Yuan, Hailian; Wang, Hongyan; Wang, Cheng; Shen, Jie; Jiang, Xinru; Fu, Xiaoyan; Du, Xianhong; Peng, Jinxiu; Xiang, Miao; Zhou, Jiaqi; Sun, Nengjin; Wang, Kaile; Li, Panpan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物碱抗炎机制，涉及NF-kappaB通路和分子对接预测IKKbeta靶点，但核心是炎症信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inflammation is a critical defense mechanism whose dysregulation underpins numerous diseases. Natural products, particularly isoquinoline alkaloids, are valuable sources for anti-inflammatory drug discovery due to their structural diversity and multi-target potential. Hypecoum erectum (H. erectum), a traditional medicinal plant, is rich in isoquinoline alkaloids, but its active anti-inflammatory constituents and their mechanisms remain unclear. METHODS: Four isoquinoline alkaloids were isolated from H. erectum. Their anti-inflammatory activities and cytotoxicities were screened in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. The most promising candidate, leptocaramine, was further evaluated for its broad-spectrum efficacy across multiple in vitro models (using LPS, PGN and HSV-1 stimuli) and cell types (RAW264.7, mouse peritoneal macrophages and THP-1 cells). RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq), bioinformatics analysis and qPCR were employed to investigate the transcriptomic changes and mechanism of action. Immunoblotting and target prediction were used to elucidate the signaling pathways involved. RESULTS: Among the four alkaloids, leptocaramine exhibited the most potent anti-inflammatory activity with minimal cytotoxicity. It demonstrated broad-spectrum efficacy by significantly inhibiting pro-inflammatory mediator production across all tested in vitro models. RNA-seq analysis revealed that leptocaramine profoundly suppressed the LPS-induced inflammatory transcriptome. Functional enrichment highlighted a marked downregulation of genes in immune and cytokine-related pathways, with colony-stimulating factor 2 (CSF2/GM-CSF) being a key suppressed target. Mechanistically, leptocaramine specifically inhibited the NF-kappaB signaling pathway without affecting MAPK, and molecular docking predicted IKKbeta as its direct binding target. Furthermore, leptocaramine's anti-inflammatory effect was compromised by exogenous CSF2, indicating the disruption of a CSF2-mediated positive feedback loop. CONCLUSION: This study identifies leptocaramine as a novel broad-spectrum anti-inflammatory isoquinoline alkaloid from H. erectum. Its primary mechanism involves suppressing the NF-kappaB pathway-potentially via direct IKKbeta inhibition-and disrupting the CSF2-driven inflammatory amplification loop. Leptocaramine emerges as a promising lead compound for the development of new anti-inflammatory therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 背景：炎症是一种关键的防御机制，其失调是众多疾病的基础。天然产物，尤其是异喹啉生物碱（isoquinoline alkaloids），因其结构多样性和多靶点潜力，是抗炎药物发现的重要来源。直立角茴香（Hypecoum erectum, H. erectum）是一种传统药用植物，富含异喹啉生物碱，但其活性抗炎成分及其作用机制尚不明确。方法：从直立角茴香中分离出四种异喹啉生物碱。在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中筛选其抗炎活性和细胞毒性。最具潜力的候选化合物leptocaramine进一步在多种体外模型（使用LPS、肽聚糖（PGN）和单纯疱疹病毒1型（HSV-1）刺激）和细胞类型（RAW264.7、小鼠腹腔巨噬细胞和THP-1细胞）中评估其广谱疗效。采用RNA测序（RNA-seq）、生物信息学分析和定量PCR（qPCR）研究转录组变化和作用机制。使用免疫印迹和靶点预测阐明涉及的信号通路。结果：在四种生物碱中，leptocaramine表现出最强的抗炎活性且细胞毒性最小。它在所有测试的体外模型中通过显著抑制促炎介质产生，展现出广谱疗效。RNA-seq分析显示，leptocaramine深刻抑制了LPS诱导的炎症转录组。功能富集分析突出显示了免疫和细胞因子相关通路基因的显著下调，其中集落刺激因子2（CSF2/GM-CSF）是关键抑制靶点。机制上，leptocaramine特异性抑制NF-kappaB信号通路而不影响MAPK，分子对接预测IKKbeta为其直接结合靶点。此外，外源性CSF2削弱了leptocaramine的抗炎效果，表明其破坏了CSF2介导的正反馈环路。结论：本研究将leptocaramine鉴定为来自直立角茴香的新型广谱抗炎异喹啉生物碱。其主要机制涉及抑制NF-kappaB通路——可能通过直接抑制IKKbeta——并破坏CSF2驱动的炎症放大环路。Leptocaramine有望成为开发新型抗炎治疗药物的先导化合物。
